title: Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken & Feta
description: Grilled chicken breast over a classic Greek salad of cucumber, tomato, olives and feta.
steps: Season and grill the chicken until cooked through, then slice.
Toss the cucumber, tomato, onion, feta and olives with oil, lemon juice and oregano.
Top the salad with the sliced chicken.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food Mediterranean recipe collection

notes: Salt the feta and olives already bring is usually enough — go easy on extra salt.
